param.sysdesc: FSW stable is declared after the String has been running in the Prime state for this parameterized time. When FSW stable is declared, FSW does the following: 1) Set FSW image selection pointer (CRCs) to the bank associated with the "current image" 2) Set use_image_selection_pointer = true 3) Clear the reset counter
param.rationale: 3 hours. FSW should be stable within 3 hours.

param.sysdesc: MON_AVS_COOL_BOOT system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: One time event (per boot)

param.sysdesc: MON_AVS_COOL_BOOT system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- PRE_SEP POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST
param.rationale: System response is enabled for all modes except SYS_TEST

param.sysdesc: MON_AVS_UNCOOL_BOOT system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: One time event (per boot)

param.sysdesc: MON_AVS_UNCOOL_BOOT system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- PRE_SEP POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST
param.rationale: System response is enabled for all modes except SYS_TEST

param.sysdesc: MON_AVS_ZOMBIE system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: One time event (per boot)

param.sysdesc: MON_AVS_ZOMBIE system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- PRE_SEP POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST
param.rationale: System response is enabled for all modes except SYS_TEST

param.sysdesc: FSW will fatal if prime initialization takes longer than the value of this parameter. FSW starts the timer when prime initialization starts.
param.rationale: Allow time for FSW to do the prime init actions ... but not too much time.

param.sysdesc: In Zombie mode, if a FSW-induced fatal is declared, the FSW will delay the reset so the stays up for a period of time.
param.rationale: 5 minutes allows operators to get a command in

param.sysdesc: The maximum difference allowed between SCLK and the possible source (Saved SCLK, MCLK-A, MCLK-B).
param.rationale: In order to allow a good MCLK value to be used in SCLK init, or else the saved SCLK seed value will be used.

param.sysdesc: Parameter to set the sub-seconds offset value written to the sub-seconds registers when changing time on the Online ECE (i.e. when ingesting STM). This is to account the time it takes to receive start-of-RTI (MC17) on the 1553. Without this accountability the delay would show up as drift on the Online ECE when compared to the Prime ECE. FSW in Online ECE uses this value while Prime FSW does not.
param.rationale: Nominal expected value to send Mode Code17 across the 1553 bus.

param.sysdesc: Difference tolerance between SCLK and MCLK-B for FSW to sync SCLK time to MCLK-B if autonomous behavior is enabled. For example, if absolute difference between SCLK and MCLK-B is greater than tolerance (say > default of 5 sec) the FSW will autonomously update MCLK-B with SCLK time.
param.rationale: Maintain absolute time for faults that make use of MCLK

param.sysdesc: Difference tolerance between SCLK and MCLK-A for FSW to sync SCLK time to MCLK-A if autonomous behavior is enabled. For example, if absolute difference between SCLK and MCLK-A is greater than tolerance (say > default of 5 sec) the FSW will autonomously update MCLK-A with SCLK time.
param.rationale: Maintain absolute time for faults that make use of MCLK

param.sysdesc: SCLK drift adjustment value. Use to remove detected drift between Online ECE with respect to Prime ECE. A new commanded value will add or subtract cycles from the oscillator. The physical oscillator is not touched, it's the FPGA that adds/subtracts the cycles. While intended for the Online ECE it can also be used on the Prime ECE to slowdown or speedup the concept of time (for fault injections). A higher value than the default value in this register will shorten the local timing unit's perception of one second, equivalent to speeding up the clock source. A lower value will prolong the local timing unit's perception of one second, equivalent to slowing down the clock source. See SCTAR_REG in spec, it is a 19 bit register that stores the value.

when_applied.explanation: FSW could have an unplanned reset if this parameter were applied immediately.

param.rationale: This equates to no compensation (FPGA/Hardware default value).

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_SCLK_MONOTONICITY local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: Per FM design philosophy, all local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_SCLK_MONOTONICITY local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Want to execute response immediately upon error test passing.

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_STM_INVALID_PRIME local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: Per FM design philosophy, all local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_STM_INVALID_PRIME local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Want to execute response immediately upon error test passing.

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_STM_INVALID_ONLINE local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Peristence should never be less than 3, and is sized to deal with minor hiccup in receipt of the STM.

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_STM_INVALID_ONLINE local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: Per FM design philosophy, all local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_TOO_MANY_XRTI_PULSES local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: Per FM design philosophy, all local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_TOO_MANY_XRTI_PULSES local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Want monitor to trip as soon as the error test passes

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_XRTI_LATE local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: Per FM design philosophy, all local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_TIME_XRTI_LATE local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Want monitor to trip as soon as the error test passes

param.sysdesc: The value of the seconds portion of SCLK periodically saved in shared memory.
param.rationale: The first value pulled when the record is created.

param.sysdesc: After this number of frame errors occurs during uplink, the echo buffer data product is created and sent for downlink.
param.rationale: By initial design

param.sysdesc: After this number of consecutive valid frames, the num_frm_errs_cnt parameter is reset to 0.
param.rationale: By Initial design

param.sysdesc: MON_TEL_BABBLING_UPL_RADIO_A system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Do not false trip this monitor. The underlying telemetry used for the flag is updated at 32 Hz.

param.sysdesc: MON_TEL_BABBLING_UPL_RADIO_A system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- PRE_SEP POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST
param.rationale: System response is enabled for all modes except SYS_TEST

param.sysdesc: MON_TEL_BABBLING_UPL_RADIO_B system persistence parameter.

param.sysdesc: This is the CFDP one way light time used in the computation of CFDP timers.
param.rationale: Worst case OWLT in mission is 54 minutes = 3240 seconds

param.sysdesc: This parameter contains the queuing delay used in uplink ACK timer computations.
param.rationale: Conservative number that will provide queuing delay margin for UPL_CFDP ACK timer

param.units: Number of times timer can expire
param.sysdesc: This parameter contains the limit on the number of times the ACK timer can expire
param.rationale: Conservative number that will give operators margin to handle ACK & NACK retransmissions

param.units: Number of times timer can expire
param.sysdesc: This parameter contains the limit on the number of times the NAK timer can expire.
param.rationale: Conservative number that will give operators margin to handle ACK & NACK retransmissions

param.sysdesc: This parameter contains the starting value for CFDP Class 1 inactivity timers.
param.rationale: Using 1 day in seconds as a default value

param.sysdesc: This parameter contains the starting value for CFDP Class 2 inactivity timers.
param.rationale: Using 1 day in seconds as a default value

param.sysdesc: This parameter represents the starting value for CFDP Class 2 downlink inactivity timers.
param.rationale: 24 hours for inactivity timer to count down (not including time frozen) is reasonable.

param.sysdesc: This parameter represents the limit on the number of times the ACK timer can expire.
param.rationale: Reasonable number of times to let the timer expire, after which it will trigger an EVR to be sent in addition to the EOF PDU.

param.sysdesc: This parameter represents the round trip queuing delay used in CFDP ACK timer computation. This delay is meant to take into account the time on the ground from when the EOF is received, to when the ACK(EOF) is sent.
param.rationale: Reasonable amount of time for the ground to send back an ACK(EOF)

param.sysdesc: This parameter contains the queuing delay used in uplink NAK timer computations.
param.rationale: Conservative number that will provide queuing delay margin for UPL_CFDP ACK timer

param.sysdesc: The REU timing unit provides the capability to compensate for MCLK drift with respect to the Prime ECE. A higher value than the default value in this register will shorten the REU perception of one second, equivalent to speeding up the clock source of the REU. A lower value will prolong the REUs perception of one second, equivalent to slowing down the clock source. New value (set or set/save) will take effect in the REU once an REU RESYNC is performed. See REU FDD for more details on this commanded behavior.
param.rationale: This equates to no compensation (FPGA/Hardware default value).

param.sysdesc: The REU timing unit provides the capability to compensate for MCLK drift with respect to the Prime ECE. A higher value than the default value in this register will shorten the REU perception of one second, equivalent to speeding up the clock source of the REU. A lower value will prolong the REUs perception of one second, equivalent to slowing down the clock source. New value (set or set/save) will take effect in the REU once an REU RESYNC is performed. See REU FDD for more details on this commanded behavior.
param.rationale: This equates to no compensation (FPGA/Hardware default value).

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_BAD_DSS_MEAS, TIMETAG_TOO_OLD_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Corresponds to eight 8-Hz RTIs. This is much larger than the expected latency of < 2 8-Hz RTIs.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_BAD_DSS_MEAS, TIMEOUT_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Trips if the prime DSS is powered off or marked invalid, if the Gray code is invalid (if Sun predicted in 40-deg FOV), or the timetag is persistenty old. Allow time for hot swaps of DSS with margin.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS, TIMEOUT_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Ride through SEUs on the IMU buffer electronics that produces spikes in the data - revisit for WAM to FTR transition after Special testing is complete.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST PRE_SEP
param.rationale: GNC in Reset in PRE_SEP

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Monitor will trip immediately after the threshold time without gyro data has been reached. Allows the system to gracefully handle SEUs on the IMU buffer electronics that produces spikes in the data, as well as temporary interruptions in gyro data delivery to ATE.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS, SINGLE_MEAS_TOO_OLD_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: The nominal difference in this value is 0.125 seconds. That is, the MDP timetag will nominally be 0.125 seconds behind the current rti_time that ATE processes that MDP. However, from a controller stability perspective, we can tolerate much larger latency.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS, PARITY_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Accounts for parity error due to gyro scale factor error, bias, and AWN. Driving effect is scale factor error at end-of-life under cold operating conditions. Assuming 17200 PPM (10,000 PPM EOL warm scale factor + 7200 for cold performance) under 10 deg/s max rate, we arrive at 0.004 rad. Adding 50% margin, we arrive at 0.006 rad. Given the magnitude of this error, it can not be expected as a mechanism for data editing and science performance. It can only detect a grossly misperforming gyro axis.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS, MIN_NUM_MEAS_IN_MDP_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: At least one valid gyro measurement in a data packet is required to be valid.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS, MAX_RATE_PER_GYRO_AXIS_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Utilizing the max spec limit for force-to-rebalance mode (9.5 deg/s). We intend to visit this once more after the parameters for excessive rates and relevant monitors are finalized.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS, MAX_NUM_CONST_GYRO_MEAS_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Set far beyond the max constant measurements we should ever encounter solely from angle white noise. Smaller AWN increases the probability that longer strings of constant measurements are possible. Per the vendor, the analytical minimum AWN is 0.0013 arcsec/rt(Hz), which yields the possibility that once every 100 years 13 unchanged measurements could be encountred.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS, MAX_ACC_PER_GYRO_AXIS_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Bad gyro measurement max acceleration set to a threshold large enough to eliminate the test from ever tripping independent of the other tests. This parameter still exists as a knob for the ground operaters to use.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: Per FM design philosophy, all local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Monitor will trip immediately after the threshold time without gyro data has been reached. Allows the system to gracefully handle SEUs on the IMU buffer electronics that produces spikes in the data, as well as temporary interruptions in gyro data delivery to ATE.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_GYRO_MEAS, MDP_TIMETAG_TOO_OLD_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: The nominal difference in this value is 0.125 seconds. That is, the MDP timetag will nominally be 0.125 seconds behind the current rti_time that ATE processes that MDP. However, from a controller stability perspective, we can tolerate much larger latency.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_DISCONTINUITY local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Provides robustness to false trips if the Sun direction anchor is erroneously redefined and subsequently corrected within the 40 8-Hz RTIs, where a new anchor requires a minimum of 24 8-Hz RTIs to be established as valid.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_DISCONTINUITY system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Provides robustness to false trips if the Sun direction anchor is erroneously redefined and subsequently corrected within the 40 8-Hz RTIs, where a new anchor requires a minimum of 24 8-Hz RTIs to be established as valid.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_DISCONTINUITY local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_DISCONTINUITY system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST PRE_SEP
param.rationale: Default for monitors calling SYS_RSP_RECOVER_SUN_DIR_3R

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_DISCONTINUITY, THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Allow for temporary unexpected changes in 3RS Sun direction, but only if the change is still a small angle. This will only change if the DSS-based measurements are persistently consistent, otherwise spurious measurements will be rejected.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_DIR local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Allow time for sudden discontinuities in 3J Sun direction with respect to IVP to resolve before triggering fault protection. Since this monitor is intended to detect an IVP issue (i.e., off-pointing), duration should be short enough to trip before low energy.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_DIR system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Allow time for sudden discontinuities in 3J Sun direction with respect to IVP to resolve before triggering fault protection. Since this monitor is intended to detect an IVP issue (i.e., off-pointing), duration should be short enough to trip before low energy.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_DIR local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_DIR system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST PRE_SEP
param.rationale: Default for monitors calling SYS_RSP_RECOVER_SUN_DIR_3JCEL

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_DIR, THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Allow for temporary unexpected changes in 3J Sun direction, but only if the change is still a small angle. This will only change if the DSS-based measurements are persistently consistent, otherwise spurious measurements will be rejected.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_LOSS_3R local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Only triggered if the predicted Sun is within 40-deg square FOV boresight. Allow time for unknown transient conditions to resolve before declaring an issue. Because in 3R the max rates in Launch can be up to 0.7 deg/s, don't allow too much time for errors to accumulate in pointing without a DSS measurement, which could then result in the SDE discontinuity monitor tripping. 300 sec * 0.7 deg/s * 0.01 scale factor error = 2.1 deg < discontinuity threshold.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_LOSS_3R system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Only triggered if the predicted Sun is within 40-deg square FOV boresight. Allow time for unknown transient conditions to resolve before declaring an issue. Because in 3R the max rates in Launch can be up to 0.7 deg/s, don't allow too much time for errors to accumulate in pointing without a DSS measurement, which could then result in the SDE discontinuity monitor tripping. 300 sec * 0.7 deg/s * 0.01 scale factor error = 2.1 deg < discontinuity threshold.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_LOSS_3R local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_LOSS_3R system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST PRE_SEP
param.rationale: Default for monitors calling SYS_RSP_RECOVER_SUN_DIR_3R

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_LOSS_3J local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: DSS-based knowledge is not foundational for 3J operations. However, we need to ensure we have operable DSS for 3R responses. To allow for flexible pointing and solar array motions with resulting unknown unknown loss of Sun conditions, set this to a large value.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_SDE_UNEXPECTED_SUN_LOSS_3J system persistence parameter.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_COVARIANCE_3J, ATT_X_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Intended to detect a numerically-diverging estimator. Initial attitude covariance is the driver. Would take thousands of degrees of turning in 3J with an uncalibrated IMU and during an SRU outage to exceed this threshold. Therefore, it should only be possible to arrive at this level due to divergence.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_COVARIANCE_3J, BIAS_X_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Intended to detect a numerically-diverging estimator. Initial bias covariance is the driver. It would take centuries of covariance propagation without an SRU measurement to arrive at this level. Therefore, it should only be possible to arrive at this level due to divergence.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_COVARIANCE_3J, MMATRIX_1_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Bounds the largest expected M-matrix component covariance and propagated for over 200 years without an IMU calibration. Intended to detect a numerical instability in the Kalman filter. This parameter should updated in conjunction with any parameters affecting the initial M-matrix covariance and M-matrix process noise parameters.

param.rationale: Tuned to detect numerical divergence of the filter and not used as a performance monitor. Current value is set to 3x the worst-case predict with a 60 second outage and starting from opened covariance and large rates.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_3J local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Monitor will trip immediately after the threshold time without SRU data has been reached. Allows the system to gracefully handle long SRU obscurations while gyro propagating.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_3J system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Monitor will trip immediately after the threshold time without SRU data has been reached. Allows the system to gracefully handle long SRU obscurations while gyro propagating.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_3J local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_3J system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST PRE_SEP POST_SEP
param.rationale: Default for monitors calling SYS_RSP_ISOLATE_PRIME_SRU

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_3J, TIMEOUT_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: SRU outages are expected in nominal 3J operations, but gyro propgation should be limited to ensure spacecraft safety and particularly safe pointing knowledge error in relevant error budgets.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_3J, TIMETAG_TOO_OLD_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Ensures the SRU measurement is within the estimate ring buffer and is allows for measurements older than the worst-case SRU measurement latency.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_3J, NUM_STAR_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: The minimum number of stars for the star tracker to properly track is 4.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_CEL local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Monitor will trip immediately after the threshold time without SRU data has been reached. Allows the system to gracefully handle short SRU obscurations while dynamic model propagating.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_CEL system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Monitor will trip immediately after the threshold time without SRU data has been reached. Allows the system to gracefully handle short SRU obscurations while dynamic model propagating.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_CEL, TIMEOUT_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Limit the amount of time system is without SRU measurements and forced to propagate the estimated state using the internal dynamics model. This time also provides an opportunity for designated track to return the SRU to Track after short SRU outages.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_ATE_BAD_SRU_MEAS_CEL, TIMETAG_TOO_OLD_THRSH threshold parameter.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_DVE_DELTAV_PROGRESS_ERR, ACC_DIFF_FRAC_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Effectively disables. 150 psia = 41% + RSS of common (3.9%) and differential errors (5%/sqrt(2)). Then 1.1x.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_DVE_BAD_ACCEL_MEAS, MAX_DV_PER_AXIS_THRSH threshold parameter.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_DVE_BAD_ACCEL_MEAS, MAX_NUM_CONST_MEAS_THRSH threshold parameter.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_DVE_BAD_ACCEL_MEAS, PARITY_THRSH threshold parameter.

param.sysdesc: If trying to extrapolate over a delta-time larger than this, EVR is issued
param.rationale: Because ATE ring buffer should contain old quaternion estimates with 8-Hz RTI timetags before and after SRU measurement timetag, extrapolation from SRU timetag to closest 8-Hz RTI timetag should be less than one 8-Hz period.

param.sysdesc: IMU Angle Random Walk (ARW)
param.rationale: pow(0.00015*GNC_ATE_DEGREES/sqrt(GNC_ATE_HOURS),2). 0.00015 deg/sqrt(hr) from Europa Clipper IMU Flight Hardware Detailed Specification, 4.3.2.7.2

param.sysdesc: IMU Rate Random Walk (ARW)
param.rationale: pow(0.0016*GNC_ATE_DEGREES/GNC_ATE_HOURS,2)/(1.0*GNC_ATE_HOURS). 0.0016 deg/hr and 1 hr from Europa Clipper IMU Flight Hardware Detailed Specification, 4.3.2.5.2

param.sysdesc: IMU scale-factor stability
param.rationale: pow(278.0*GNC_ATE_PARTSPERMILLION/3.0,2)/(30.0*24.0*GNC_ATE_HOURS). 278 PPM and 30 days from Europa Clipper IMU Flight Hardware Detailed Specification, 4.3.2.4.1, JPL D-100656, Revision A

param.sysdesc: IMU internal axis alignment stability
param.rationale: pow(150.0*GNC_ATE_MICRORADIANS/3.0,2)/(30.0*24.0*GNC_ATE_HOURS). 150 urad and 30 days from Europa Clipper IMU Flight Hardware Detailed Specification, 4.3.2.5.2

param.sysdesc: IMU-SRU thermal-mechanical stability
param.rationale: pow(300.0*GNC_ATE_MICRORADIANS/3.0,2)/(30.0*24.0*GNC_ATE_HOURS). 300 urad and 30 days from RQ105.595

param.sysdesc: Nominal value for each element of the M-matrix. Used to check validity of new calibrated M-matrix
param.rationale: At launch, nominal value is zero, as all errors are assumed to be at their best calibration value and zero-mean.

param.sysdesc: Allowed variation wrt nominal value for each element of the M-matrix. Used to check validity of new calibrated M-matrix
param.rationale: 27,000 PPM is larger than 22,000 PPM from P_inert_m_init_diag_BF, where 22,000 PPM is a worst-case bound on the largest element of the M-matrix at end-of-mission.

param.sysdesc: Initial diag. elements of state cov. in Celestial for rate states
param.rationale: From analysis. Corresponds to 0.115 deg/s 3-sigma. Must bound rate knowledge error in 3J, even when solar arrays are vibrating.

param.sysdesc: Initial diag. elements of state cov. in Celestial for rate states
param.rationale: From analysis. Corresponds to 0.115 deg/s 3-sigma. Must bound rate knowledge error in 3J, even when solar arrays are vibrating.

param.sysdesc: Initial diag. elements of state cov. in Celestial for rate states
param.rationale: From analysis. Corresponds to 0.115 deg/s 3-sigma. Must bound rate knowledge error in 3J, even when solar arrays are vibrating.

param.sysdesc: Initial diag. elements of state cov. in Celestial for torque states
param.rationale: Corresponds to 2.0e-4 N.m 3-sigma and is intended to bound the external torque during Cruise (i.e., solar radiation pressure). Using rate process noise for dynamic errors exceeding this magnitude. If torque estimation is ever enabled in flight, should revisit this tuning with an in-flight disturbance torque ground estimate. only is 1.3e-4 N.m.

If torque estimation is ever enabled in flight, should revisit this tuning with an in-flight disturbance torque ground estimate. only is 1.3e-4 N.m.

param.sysdesc: Diagonal of continuous-time process noise matrix associated with angle states in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Provided as an in-flight tuning knob with no pre-flight use case. Bounded flexible attitude motion errors are managed via measurement underweighting. Beyond that, rate and torque process noise errors are used to manage attitude covariance growth.

param.sysdesc: Diagonal of continuous-time process noise matrix associated with angle states in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Provided as an in-flight tuning knob with no pre-flight use case. Bounded flexible attitude motion errors are managed via measurement underweighting. Beyond that, rate and torque process noise errors are used to manage attitude covariance growth.

param.sysdesc: Diagonal of continuous-time process noise matrix associated with angle states in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Provided as an in-flight tuning knob with no pre-flight use case. Bounded flexible attitude motion errors are managed via measurement underweighting. Beyond that, rate and torque process noise errors are used to manage attitude covariance growth.

param.sysdesc: Diagonal of continuous-time process noise matrix associated with rate states in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Includes inertia knowledge errors and feedforward torque errors on RCS control. Tuned to provide the mean rate motion and will not provide an accurate representation of the flexible motions.

param.sysdesc: Diagonal of continuous-time process noise matrix associated with rate states in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Includes inertia knowledge errors and feedforward torque errors on RCS control. Tuned to provide the mean rate motion and will not provide an accurate representation of the flexible motions.

param.sysdesc: Diagonal of continuous-time process noise matrix associated with rate states in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Includes inertia knowledge errors and feedforward torque errors on RCS control. Tuned to provide the mean rate motion and will not provide an accurate representation of the flexible motions.

param.sysdesc: Diagonal of continuous-time process noise matrix associated with torque states in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Torque covariance is saturated at initialization, but this is provided as a tuning knob for in-flight. Currently set to a reasonable value for Cruise solar pressure torque management.

param.sysdesc: Diagonal of continuous-time process noise matrix associated with torque states in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Torque covariance is saturated at initialization, but this is provided as a tuning knob for in-flight. Currently set to a reasonable value for Cruise solar pressure torque management.

param.sysdesc: Diagonal of continuous-time process noise matrix associated with torque states in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Torque covariance is saturated at initialization, but this is provided as a tuning knob for in-flight. Currently set to a reasonable value for Cruise solar pressure torque management.

param.sysdesc: Saturation value for the torque covariance in BF in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Set to the initial covariance value, so that covariance cannot grow beyond initial bounds. If torque estimation is ever enabled in flight, should revisit this tuning with an in-flight disturbance torque ground estimate.

param.sysdesc: Saturation value for the torque covariance in BF in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Set to the initial covariance value, so that covariance cannot grow beyond initial bounds. If torque estimation is ever enabled in flight, should revisit this tuning with an in-flight disturbance torque ground estimate.

param.sysdesc: Saturation value for the torque covariance in BF in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Set to the initial covariance value, so that covariance cannot grow beyond initial bounds. If torque estimation is ever enabled in flight, should revisit this tuning with an in-flight disturbance torque ground estimate.

param.sysdesc: Delta-cov. to add to diag. of att. state cov. to account for SRU-to-SRU misalignments
param.rationale: 1500 urad 3-sigma is the sum of 1100 urad 3-sigma delivered to orbit knowledge (RQ105.605) + 100 urad head-to-head thermo-mechanical stability (Req 881390) + 300 urad IMU-to-SRU thermo-mechanical stability (Req 593547).

param.sysdesc: Delta-cov. to add to diag. of att. state cov. to account for SRU-to-SRU misalignments
param.rationale: 1500 urad 3-sigma is the sum of 1100 urad 3-sigma delivered to orbit knowledge (RQ105.605) + 100 urad head-to-head thermo-mechanical stability (Req 881390) + 300 urad IMU-to-SRU thermo-mechanical stability (Req 593547).

param.sysdesc: Delta-cov. to add to diag. of att. state cov. to account for SRU-to-SRU misalignments
param.rationale: 1500 urad 3-sigma is the sum of 1100 urad 3-sigma delivered to orbit knowledge (RQ105.605) + 100 urad head-to-head thermo-mechanical stability (Req 881390) + 300 urad IMU-to-SRU thermo-mechanical stability (Req 593547).

param.sysdesc: Saturation value for rate estimate in BF in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Saturate beyond the highest possible SRU tracking rate. NOTE: above 0.5 deg/sec, the SRU is not guaranteed to track in low radiation and above 0.18 deg/s in high radiation. However, it's possible the SRU may track at higher rates, particularly in Hydra mode.

param.sysdesc: Saturation value for rate estimate in BF in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Saturate beyond the highest possible SRU tracking rate. NOTE: above 0.5 deg/sec, the SRU is not guaranteed to track in low radiation and above 0.18 deg/s in high radiation. However, it's possible the SRU may track at higher rates, particularly in Hydra mode.

param.sysdesc: Saturation value for rate estimate in BF in Celestial mode
param.rationale: Saturate beyond the highest possible SRU tracking rate. NOTE: above 0.5 deg/sec, the SRU is not guaranteed to track in low radiation and above 0.18 deg/s in high radiation. However, it's possible the SRU may track at higher rates, particularly in Hydra mode.

param.sysdesc: Number of good 100-Hz gyro packets reserved for filter convergence. Note that 3R and Cel-to-3J is declared valid after this number of good packets
param.rationale: Settling time of rate filter is 0.16 sec. After 48 good packets, rate filter should be fully converged.

param.sysdesc: Max. number of IMU MDPs processed during a 8-Hz period during AKR
param.rationale: CPU timing test indicated <= 4 MDPs/RTI may fit alongside EMT processing. Using 3 MDPs/RTI to provide some margin to prevent overrun.

param.sysdesc: If time gap between the last saved RTI time and first propagation end time in AKR is larger than this value, gap is declared too large.
param.rationale: AVS is required to limit data gaps to < 10 seconds and testing has demonstrated gaps between 4-7 seconds.

param.sysdesc: Persistency limit, in number of 8-Hz RTIs, for declaring AKR done
param.rationale: Ensures the real-time MDP is reliable before declaring AKR is successful and transitioning to a mode that processes the real-time MDP.

param.sysdesc: Persistency limit, in number of SRU measurement updates, for declaring Celestial knowledge initialized
param.rationale: Closed-loop control in ATE Celestial mode is not initialized until the rate and quaternion estimates have converged. 15 SRU measurements balances robustness in obtaining enough measurements over 75 seconds to proceed to the Celestial control modes with the rate error handed off to the controller and the resulting transient response.

param.sysdesc: Angle threshold between seed and current estimate of q_AKAF_IF
param.rationale: Consistent with ATE parameter P_inert_att_init_diag_BF

param.sysdesc: Persistency limit, in number of consecutive SRU measurements, for declaring bad seed for q_AFAF_IF. Only SRU measurements that passed processing are counted.
param.rationale: Set to be robust against a single outlier in the initialization of the 3J Kalman filter, but set small to increase the probability of success.

param.sysdesc: Persistency limit, in number of SRU measurements, for declaring good seed for q_AFAF_IF. Only meas that passed processing are counted. Meas do not need to be consecutive. The seed itself counts as 1.
param.rationale: Set to be robust against a single outlier in the initialization of the 3J Kalman filter, but set small to increase the probability of success.

param.sysdesc: Maximum angular rate at which interpolated quaternion converges to optimal quaternion during SQUID
param.rationale: By analysis. Corresponds to sqrt(3*(1.36e-3)^2) rad in 5 min. Used to reduce knowledge transients passed to the controller.

param.sysdesc: Maximum time SQUID takes to converge interpolated quaternion to optimal quaternion.
param.rationale: By analysis. Sets a bound on how long SQUID can be active for a given instance. Used to reduce knowledge transients passed to the controller and tuned in conjuction with the max SQUID rate.

param.sysdesc: Max time without a successful SRU meas updt in 3J mode before the SQUID algorithm is armed
param.rationale: By analysis. Ensures that accumulation of M-matrix errors during slews are profiled out even during short SRU outages.

param.rationale: All elements contributing to M-matrix error are calibrated prior to Launch with residuals assumed to be zero-mean.

param.sysdesc: Cosine of the keep-out-zone half-cone angle for the SRU OH A to Sun constraint
param.rationale: Monitors the commanded attitude. Must inflate the KOZ for the control and knowledge errors to provide Sun safety: 35.00 deg Requirement value + 5.85 deg for control errors (i.e., sqrt(3)*3.38deg for 3J_FANBEAM) + 0.80 deg for knowledge errors + 0.33 deg for angular size of the Sun at 0.82 AU

param.sysdesc: Cosine of the keep-out-zone half-cone angle for the SRU OH B to Sun constraint
param.rationale: Monitors the commanded attitude. Must inflate the KOZ for the control and knowledge errors to provide Sun safety: 35.00 deg Requirement value + 5.85 deg for control errors (i.e., sqrt(3)*3.38deg for 3J_FANBEAM) + 0.80 deg for knowledge errors + 0.33 deg for angular size of the Sun at 0.82 AU

param.sysdesc: Cosine of the keep-out-zone half-cone angle for the SUDA to Sun constraint
param.rationale: Monitors the commanded attitude. Uses the exact Sun safety angle of 45 deg from SUDA Sun KOZ requirement. Does not include any padding to account for off-nominal GNC control/knowledge errors to avoid inflating SUDA Sun KOZ violation monitor trigger zone.

param.sysdesc: Cosine of the keep-out-zone half-cone angle for the UVS to Sun constraint
param.rationale: Monitors the commanded attitude. Must inflate the KOZ for the control and knowledge errors to provide Sun safety: 20.00 deg Requirement value + 4.78 deg for control errors (i.e., sqrt(2)*3.38deg for 3J_FANBEAM) + 0.80 deg for knowledge errors + 0.13 deg for angular size of the Sun at 0.82 AU

param.sysdesc: Cosine of the keep-out-zone half-cone angle for the PosY to Sun constraint
param.rationale: Monitors the commanded attitude. Must inflate the KOZ for the control and knowledge errors to provide Sun safety: 45.00 deg Requirement value + 4.78 deg for control errors (i.e., sqrt(2)*3.38deg for 3J_FANBEAM) + 0.80 deg for knowledge errors + 0.13 deg for angular size of the Sun at 0.82 AU

param.sysdesc: Cosine of the keep-out-zone half-cone angle for the placeholder constraint 3.

param.sysdesc: Cosine of the keep-out-zone half-cone angle for the placeholder constraint 4.

param.sysdesc: Cosine of the keep-in-zone half-cone angle for the NegY to Sun constraint. Implemented using a large KOZ on the anti-parallel body vector (i.e., +Y)
param.rationale: Monitors the commanded attitude. Must inflate the KOZ for the control and knowledge errors to provide Sun safety. In this case, the required value is 5-deg, but the control and knowledge errors can potentially exceed that 5-deg allocation. This is known and accepted in the thermal analysis. Further, the commanded attitude may have a 1.2 deg offset applied. As a result, the parameter is set as a small KOZ inflation with respect to the known offset (i.e., 1.5 deg total).

param.sysdesc: Maximum allowable time within the keep-out-zone before a violation is declared for the SRU OH A to Sun constraint
param.rationale: The SRU constraint is based on thermal violations in Inner Cruise. The following interparameter constraint should be maintained -- max_exposure_time = 0.0 -OR- max_exposure_time > look_ahead_time.

param.rationale: The UVS is highly sensitive to the SUN in the FOV for portions of the mission. The following interparameter constraint should be maintained -- max_exposure_time = 0.0 -OR- max_exposure_time > look_ahead_time.

param.rationale: Several components are sensitive to Sun exposure on the +Y side of the spacecraft. The following interparameter constraint should be maintained -- max_exposure_time = 0.0 -OR- max_exposure_time > look_ahead_time.

param.rationale: When < 2.0 AU distance from the Sun, off-Sun (i.e., -Y not aligned with the Sun direction) time should be limited to prevent hardware damage.

param.sysdesc: Rate that integrated exposure time is decayed back to zero when the keep-out-zone is not currently violated for the SUDA to Sun constraint
param.rationale: Use a decay rate (1e5 s/s) to drastically reduce the duration of time periods where the Sun is no longer incident on the SUDA detector but SUDA is unable ramp up HV due monitor still being active. This value is chosen to ensure that the decay rate period corresponding to the longest SUDA Sun KOZ violations expected for Tour is <30 seconds. Operationally, it is desired to be able to return SUDA to a science configuration ASAP after the end of a Sun KOZ violation, since several Sun KOZ occur near C/A, when the most critical SUDA science is acquired.

param.sysdesc: Vector propagation interval length. Changing this param may require changing the num_ivp_emt_row_proc_per_rti param.
param.rationale: From analysis. Interval length must be long enough to finish processing EMT and triple/routine evaluating vectors, but must be small enough to keep cubic spline interpolation error below 10 urad. Assumption that EMT is 250 rows.

param.sysdesc: Number of Kepler iterations after initialization. conic_iter_min should be less than conic_iter_max.
param.rationale: From analysis and Cassini heritage

param.sysdesc: Number of Kepler iterations at initialization. conic_iter_min should be less than conic_iter_max.
param.rationale: From analysis and Cassini heritage

param.sysdesc: Number of IVP EMT rows checked per RTI. Changing this param may require changing the delta_time param. There are also processing concerns if the parameter value is increased. For an EMT with 250 rows and num_ivp_emt_row_proc_per_rti set to 25, it should take less than 82 seconds to finish processing EMT and triple/routine evaluating vectors.
param.rationale: From analysis and testing. Value needs to be large enough to finish processing EMT and evaluating vectors, but must be small enough to allow computations to finish in an RTI. Assumption that EMT is 250 rows.

param.sysdesc: number of RTIs per IVP interval when EPM can swap EMT pointers
param.rationale: EPM swaps EMT pointer every time IVP flags that it is okay. Value of 1 allows EPM to swap pointers once per IVP interval.

param.sysdesc: Accel accum delta-v quantization
param.rationale: JPL D-100656 Rev A, Section 4.3.3.4 Accelerometer Resolution

param.sysdesc: Required fraction of valid acc meas in a cal
param.rationale: Do not want too tight in case of unexpected radiation effects. If an isolated drop, removes two cal measurements (b/c need difference). So for isolated drops, 0.5 -> 75% measurements received. Could have a 50% contiguous drop, in which case bad accel monitor would trip. Also, for nominal cal time of 120 s, can handle 60 s: OTM reconstruction margin goes from 16% to 12% and Gates budget includes 5 min of accel walk after cal when FR has at most 40 s, so margin there as well.

param.sysdesc: Time from center of measurement interval to start of 32-Hz RTI. Used for model-based propagation up to start of RTI.
param.rationale: From transport delay budget based on D-56723 IMU IICD (Initial Release 2019-03-20), confirmed by IMU modeler, and calc of average Butterworth delay. Also tuned empirically in GIST with actual Butterworth for max/min transport delay and got same value.

param.sysdesc: Last ATE q propagated this duration to get average quaterion for transforming DV estimates in BF to IF. Not used for DV's, but provides opportunistic DV estiamte in IF for slews and other RCS activities.
param.rationale: Tuned so accel est with model replacement and purely model-based match (former propagates from time of measurement to now whereas latter propagates only over last 32-Hz RTI). Tuned value compares favorably with temporal midpoint of all propagations of ~128 ms. Is related to acc_meas_delay, but independent for separate tuning.

param.sysdesc: Use model-predicted accel instead of measurements for cutting off burn
param.rationale: Trust measurements if available

param.sysdesc: Total scale factor (1+eps) Parameter name with expanded enums: GNC_DVE_ACC_SCF_{ 0 = IMU_MGR_IMU_A }_{ 0 = IMU_MGR_ACCEL_A }
param.rationale: Accel scale factor calibrated as part of IMU delivery. No better knowledge pre-launch.

param.sysdesc: Delay from start of current 32-Hz RTI to received by PME
param.rationale: Two 32-Hz RTIs per Req 607756:L4-AVS-Engine Command Rate & Latency. Req includes another 50 us in bound (so 0.06255 s) for internal PME response, but want just cmd transport time.

param.sysdesc: Max magnitude of estimated accel biases for validity
param.rationale: Spec is RSS(1,0.2)+13.6 = 14.6 mg with radiation at EOL from JPL IOM 3435-21-015A. Added ~50% margin. Don't want too large because catches an out-of-family accel. Bounds are post-launch spec to 100x spec.

param.sysdesc: Threshold for z_BF/dv-dir alignment for initiating delta-v
param.rationale: Direction consistency check. Value is cos(5*DEG_2_RAD) to allow for off-pointing (i.e., primary body is DELTAV_BF, not Z_BF).

param.sysdesc: Duration for each delta-v phase (2/4/6/8 eng)
param.rationale: Sufficient time for integrator to act before proceeding to new disturbance from additional engines.

param.sysdesc: DV phase that a DV begins in.
param.rationale: 2-engine off-pulsing to meet Gates Pointing at 3-sigma. For upper_bound, 10 engines in HIT has been approved, so can start on 8 Z-pointed.

param.sysdesc: DV phase that a DV stops in
param.rationale: Leave 8-engine as default max

param.sysdesc: Specifies spacecraft deployed configuration. Parameter decides mass properties (stowed or deployed) to use in GNC algorithms
param.rationale: Safe default defined in "GNC Set Functions (The Setters)" from August 11, 2020, Slide 4

param.sysdesc: Specifies sun search and sun acq agility parameter sets after deployment started. Selectable between SUPER_SAFE, SPRINT, and SAFE (LAUNCH option is prohibited).
param.rationale: Safe default defined in "GNC Set Functions (The Setters)" from August 11, 2020, Slide 4

param.sysdesc: Minimum number of 8 Hz RTIs before allowing transition out of RECOVER3J. Minimum time in RECOVER3J provides predictability and allows time for thruster or wheels to be set up before being used for control. GNC_EXC_MIN_NUM_RTI_IN_RECOVER3J_0 is used for RCS and GNC_EXC_MIN_NUM_RTI_IN_RECOVER3J_1 is used for RWA.
param.rationale: For RCS, no additional prep time needed to configure PME/thrusters. For RWA, seven seconds for reaction wheel power-on time + eight seconds for RWE settle time + one second margin

param.sysdesc: Minimum number of 8 Hz RTIs before allowing transition out of RECOVER3J. Minimum time in RECOVER3J provides predictability and allows time for thruster or wheels to be set up before being used for control. GNC_EXC_MIN_NUM_RTI_IN_RECOVER3J_0 is used for RCS and GNC_EXC_MIN_NUM_RTI_IN_RECOVER3J_1 is used for RWA.
param.rationale: For RCS, no additional prep time needed to configure PME/thrusters. For RWA, seven seconds for reaction wheel power-on time + eight seconds for RWE settle time + one second margin

param.sysdesc: Reaction wheel speed limit in TEST mode. Wheel torque command will be zeroed if limit is exceeded.
param.rationale: Europa Clipper operational speed limit

param.sysdesc: Maximum duration to send EVRs when TEST_PUBLISH_EVR command is executed in TEST mode.
param.rationale: Based on 20 EVRs per second FSW EVR_SVC requirement. Most devices (the exception being IMU and THR) will not flood the EVR system at the max duration.

param.sysdesc: Solar array settling delta time [s] indication used for MBM. Settling time is counted from the RTI after the last step is commanded and does not include backporch time. Settling time is expected to always be larger than backporch time.
param.rationale: From analysis with RWC controller, G1B+ LMM, and high fidelity SADA, solar arrays settle by 3 minutes and pointing requirements can be met with more than 50% margin.

param.rationale: Spurious measurements should not trigger miscompare EVR

param.rationale: Threshold should be large enough to handle nominal miscompares due to head-to-head errors

param.sysdesc: Triggers a reseed for consistency checking when too many bad measurements are encountered
param.rationale: Prevents up to 2 spurious measurements from causing a reseed.

param.sysdesc: Angle that measurements must be within the initial seed to be considered good
param.rationale: Defines the error bounds for consistency checking and spans the range of several nominal DSS bit transitions.

param.sysdesc: angle that the Sun must have moved in the body frame over the consistency check to be considered good
param.rationale: Ensures the gyro-based propagation and DSS measurements are in agreement across multiple DSS bit transitions

param.sysdesc: DSSE circuit sun presence threshold test value per DSS gain
param.rationale: Recreation of the test performed within the DSSE using the analog ATA voltage. Vc > Vthresh, where Vc = 4/9 * (V_ataA + V_ataB) and Gain 0, 1 --> Vthresh = 5 volt * 1.0kOhm / (1.0kOhm + 64.9kOhm ) Gain 2, 3 --> Vthresh = 5 volt * ( 1.0kOhm + 2.32kOhm ) / ( 1.0kOhm + 2.32kOhm + 64.9kOhm ) Therefore, Gain 0, 1 --> V_ataA + v_ataB > 0.1707132018 Gain 2, 3 --> V_ataA + v_ataB > 0.5474934037

param.sysdesc: persistence limit for head 2 Sun presence miscompare before generating an EVR. No other autonomous response is taken.
param.rationale: Sun presence bits should not persistently miscompare between the prime and backup sensors

param.sysdesc: persistence limit for head 2 albedo alpha bit miscompare before generating an EVR. No other autonomous response is taken.
param.rationale: Albedo presence bits should not persistently miscompare between the prime and backup sensors

param.sysdesc: persistence limit for head 2 albedo beta bit miscompare before generating an EVR. No other autonomous response is taken.
param.rationale: Albedo presence bits should not persistently miscompare between the prime and backup sensors

param.sysdesc: Min combustion aka burn time
param.rationale: Need > ~1 ms burn with timing uncertainties but also a size that allows SuperSafe design to close. 5.3 ms has > 0.7 ms for all thrusters except 10, which is 0.2 ms due to being an outlier. PROP assessing.

param.sysdesc: Delay from start of current 8-Hz RTI to received by TCD
param.rationale: Data from current RTI of 8-Hz GNC Task transferred to 32-Hz GNC Task on next major RTI

param.sysdesc: Delay from start of current 8-Hz RTI to received by PME
param.rationale: Data from current RTI of 8-Hz GNC Task transferred to 32-Hz GNC Task on next major RTI. Then one 32-Hz tick of TCD and one 32-Hz tick of bus transfer.

param.sysdesc: Nominal valve opening time
param.rationale: PROP ATP data with average values fit with functional approx. to solenoid opening response. Then fit evaluated at the predicted thruster feed voltage with Golden Node at nominal voltage (32.8 V) and two thrusters in HIT. Line drop from node to thrusters from PWR analysis of line drop.

param.sysdesc: Nominal valve closing time from HIT
param.rationale: PROP ATP data with average fit with functional approx. to solenoid closing response. Then fit evaluated at the predicted thruster feed voltage with Golden Node at nominal voltage (32.8 V) and two thrusters in HIT. Line drop from node to thrusters from PWR analysis of line drop.

param.sysdesc: Nominal valve closing time from HOLD
param.rationale: PROP ATP data with average fit with functional approx. to solenoid response. Then fit evaluated at 5V and 8.5 V, which bound the HOLD voltage. Value is average of end points. Range is +/-0.1 ms.

param.sysdesc: Set of Zptd thrusters (inner or outer) to allocate first
param.rationale: Inner for smaller min torque impulse to support Supersafe on Launch

param.sysdesc: For 2-thruster off-pulsing, corners to use first
param.rationale: Arbitrary. Will be toggled throughout mission.

param.sysdesc: For 6-thruster off-pulsing, corners to use first
param.rationale: Arbitrary. Will be toggled throughout mission.

param.sysdesc: Nominal thruster forces, indexed zero-offset in HELIX.
param.rationale: From thruster ATP steady-state firing data with Pfeed = Ptank = 225 psia, midoint of Launch-Phase range. Uses mdot vs Pfeed and force vs total_mdot correlations. Using average value over all thrusters for all thrusters. Variation from average is approx +/-1.5% at 150 psia, reducing to +/-0.5% by ~200 psia. So using individual values not deemed worth the complexity and reduced clarity of interpretation.

param.sysdesc: Tolerance on matrix determinant that indicates singularity
param.rationale: Given thruster configuration, determinant of allocation matrices is around 800. Go about six orders of magnitude smaller.

param.sysdesc: Time added to pulse dur if pulsing at end of cmd period
param.rationale: Max allowed (255*0.25 - 31.25 ms) to handle a single dropped bus message. Otherwise would need only a few ms.

This DCM was then used to calculate the boresight vector.

param.rationale: Based on T. Lui 3J RCS control design - both feedforward types enabled

param.rationale: Based on T. Lui Celestial RCS control design - both feedforward types enabled

param.rationale: Based on T. Lui Celestial RCS control design - both feedforward types enabled

param.sysdesc: Feedforward torque enable flag (0 = Off, 1 = On) for 3J RWA controllers. Gyroscopic feedforward is mapped to index 0 and solar array feedforward is mapped to index 1. Parameter name with expanded enums: GNC_EXC_FFWD_ENABLE_3J_RWA_{ 0 = GNC_EXC_FFWD_GYROSCOPIC }
param.rationale: Based on M. Flores 3J RWA control design - both feedforward types enabled. GNC CDR analysis demonstrated the need for solar array feedforward in 3J. L4 GNC V&V analysis presented on 02/23/2021 demonstrated the need for gyroscopic feedforward in 3J/Celestial.

param.sysdesc: Feedforward torque enable flag (0 = Off, 1 = On) for 3J RWA controllers. Gyroscopic feedforward is mapped to index 0 and solar array feedforward is mapped to index 1. Parameter name with expanded enums: GNC_EXC_FFWD_ENABLE_3J_RWA_{ 1 = GNC_EXC_FFWD_SOLAR_ARRAY }
param.rationale: Based on M. Flores 3J RWA control design - both feedforward types enabled. GNC CDR analysis demonstrated the need for solar array feedforward in 3J. L4 GNC V&V analysis presented on 02/23/2021 demonstrated the need for gyroscopic feedforward in 3J/Celestial.

param.sysdesc: Feedforward torque enable flag (0 = Off, 1 = On) for Celestial RWA controllers. Gyroscopic feedforward is mapped to index 0 and solar array feedforward is mapped to index 1. Parameter name with expanded enums: GNC_EXC_FFWD_ENABLE_CEL_RWA_{ 0 = GNC_EXC_FFWD_GYROSCOPIC }
param.rationale: Based on M. Flores Celestial RWA control design - both feedforward types enabled. L4 GNC V&V analysis presented on 02/23/2021 demonstrated the need for gyroscopic feedforward in 3J/Celestial. Decision to enable SA feedforward made during the B9 design cycle (already needed in 3J and should only help in Celestial).

param.sysdesc: Feedforward torque enable flag (0 = Off, 1 = On) for Celestial RWA controllers. Gyroscopic feedforward is mapped to index 0 and solar array feedforward is mapped to index 1. Parameter name with expanded enums: GNC_EXC_FFWD_ENABLE_CEL_RWA_{ 1 = GNC_EXC_FFWD_SOLAR_ARRAY }
param.rationale: Based on M. Flores Celestial RWA control design - both feedforward types enabled. L4 GNC V&V analysis presented on 02/23/2021 demonstrated the need for gyroscopic feedforward in 3J/Celestial. Decision to enable SA feedforward made during the B9 design cycle (already needed in 3J and should only help in Celestial).

param.sysdesc: Number of (8 Hz) RTIs before indicating settled in SLEW and settled in TRACK for RCS nominal scenarios (i.e., turns in ACQ3J, POINTRCS3J, POINTRCSCEL, and POINTRCS3JTRAN that are not for cooling or coming from an RWA mode). Specifically, the first value represents the number of RTIs to settle in SLEW submode after the turn is completed and before transitioning to TRACK submode. The second value represents the number of RTIs to settle in TRACK submode. The sum of both values determines when the turn is declared settled.
param.rationale: Settle time design for Supersafe controllers. Since Supersafe Slew is a deadband controller with larger deadbands than Supersafe Track, set settle to 0s on Supersafe Slew. T. Lui's RCS Supersafe Monte Carlo results show that 900s is sufficient (with margin) to complete and settle feedback slew from Supersafe Slew to Supersafe Track.

param.sysdesc: Number of (8 Hz) RTIs before indicating settled in SLEW and settled in TRACK for RCS nominal scenarios (i.e., turns in ACQ3J, POINTRCS3J, POINTRCSCEL, and POINTRCS3JTRAN that are not for cooling or coming from an RWA mode). Specifically, the first value represents the number of RTIs to settle in SLEW submode after the turn is completed and before transitioning to TRACK submode. The second value represents the number of RTIs to settle in TRACK submode. The sum of both values determines when the turn is declared settled.
param.rationale: Settle time design for Supersafe controllers. Since Supersafe Slew is a deadband controller with larger deadbands than Supersafe Track, set settle to 0s on Supersafe Slew. T. Lui's RCS Supersafe Monte Carlo results show that 900s is sufficient (with margin) to complete and settle feedback slew from Supersafe Slew to Supersafe Track.

param.sysdesc: Number of (8 Hz) RTIs before indicating settled in SLEW and settled in TRACK for RCS cooling scenarios (i.e., transitions from DELTAV3J->POINTRCS3J and MOMCTRL3J->POINTRCS3J). Specifically, the first value represents the number of RTIs to settle in SLEW submode after the turn is completed and before transitioning to TRACK submode. The second value represents the number of RTIs to settle in TRACK submode. The sum of both values determines when the turn is declared settled.
param.rationale: Consistent with 15 minutes settle time booked in manuever timelines. Use 0s to settle in SLEW after turn is completed and 900s to settle in TRACK per D. Scharf analysis (for delta-v reconstruction/prediction requirements and prop budget). Keeps pulses down for cooling phase following momentum biases and delta-V's.

param.sysdesc: Number of (8 Hz) RTIs before indicating settled in SLEW and settled in TRACK for RCS cooling scenarios (i.e., transitions from DELTAV3J->POINTRCS3J and MOMCTRL3J->POINTRCS3J). Specifically, the first value represents the number of RTIs to settle in SLEW submode after the turn is completed and before transitioning to TRACK submode. The second value represents the number of RTIs to settle in TRACK submode. The sum of both values determines when the turn is declared settled.
param.rationale: Consistent with 15 minutes settle time booked in manuever timelines. Use 0s to settle in SLEW after turn is completed and 900s to settle in TRACK per D. Scharf analysis (for delta-v reconstruction/prediction requirements and prop budget). Keeps pulses down for cooling phase following momentum biases and delta-V's.

param.sysdesc: Number of (8 Hz) RTIs after turn is complete before declaring turn settled for RWA nominal scenarios (i.e., turns in POINTRWA3J POINTRWACEL, and POINTRWA3JTRAN).
param.rationale: Based on G. Singh settle time design; 0s for RWA turns

param.sysdesc: Number of times covariances will be opened as a hardcoded action to attempt to correct a large SNI condition. Exceedance of this threshold serves as a precondition for the large SRU update fault monitors.
param.rationale: ATE attempts to resolve the issue of large SRU updates a single time before system fault protection takes action.

param.sysdesc: Number of consecutive large SNI measurements before hardcoded action to open covariances
param.rationale: Spurious measurements will not trigger the hardcoded action. Only persistent large SRU updates will result in the opening of covariances. Chosen to take no longer than 15 seconds at 2 Hz to trip to bound the SRU outage time.

param.sysdesc: Initial diag. elements of state cov. in Celestial for attitude states
param.rationale: Bounds the largest initial attitude error using SRU measurements at Celestial Kalman filter initialization, including the worst-case error between SRU optical heads.

param.sysdesc: Saturation value for attitude innovations in 3J. Primarily intended to bound the ingested error when covariances are opened.
param.rationale: Limits the permitted change when opening covariances. Set larger than expected worst-case propagation errors while in 3J without SRU measurements. Generally, spurious outlier measurements may be edited out and SQUID will gracefully handle the saturated innovations when covariances are opened.

param.sysdesc: Saturation value for attitude innovations in Celestial. Primarily intended to bound the ingested error when covariances are opened.
param.rationale: Limits the permitted change when opening covariances. The Celestial threshold needs to be smaller than the 3J version because there is no SQUID in Celestial and thus the full extent of knowledge errors is deposited on the controllers when ingested.

param.sysdesc: Flag that identifies if ATE should mark the SRU CDP invalid while initializing Celestial knowledge */
param.rationale: ATE will report quaternions and rates as invalid commands to the SRU until ATE declares celestial knowledge fully initialized

param.sysdesc: Duration an accel cal is valid for. Parity check done only with 4 accels and valid cal.
param.rationale: Max value unless issue. 1 day in seconds is >3x margin on 6.9-hr JOI (6001 kg, 303 s, 8*27.6 N, 93% duty cycle, 1000 m/s). Restarts will have re-cals. Do not want CA to trip parity if doing Tour with 4 accels (cal at CA-3 days). Upper bound for parity threshold sized for 1 day of accel random walk. Lower bound is 7 hr for JOI.

param.sysdesc: Number of (8 Hz) RTIs before indicating settled in SLEW and settled in TRACK for RCS scenarios coming from RWA control modes (i.e., transtions from POINTRWA3J->POINTRCS3J and POINTRWACEL->POINTRCSCEL). Specifically, the first value represents the number of RTIs to settle in SLEW submode after the turn is completed and before transitioning to TRACK submode. The second value represents the number of RTIs to settle in TRACK submode. The sum of both values determines when the turn is declared settled.
param.rationale: Design choice from May 2021. Control errors from RWA modes will be much smaller than those in RCS modes, so zero settle time is needed in SLEW and TRACK when coming from RWA modes.

param.sysdesc: DSSE circuit sun presence threshold test value per DSS gain
param.rationale: Recreation of the test performed within the DSSE using the analog ATA voltage. Vc > Vthresh, where Vc = 4/9 * (V_ataA + V_ataB) and Gain 0, 1 --> Vthresh = 5 volt * 1.0kOhm / (1.0kOhm + 64.9kOhm ) Gain 2, 3 --> Vthresh = 5 volt * ( 1.0kOhm + 2.32kOhm ) / ( 1.0kOhm + 2.32kOhm + 64.9kOhm ) Therefore, Gain 0, 1 --> V_ataA + v_ataB > 0.1707132018 Gain 2, 3 --> V_ataA + v_ataB > 0.5474934037

param.sysdesc: Provides the ability to disable the use of the MDP Sun presence bit on a per-head basis in the event of a stuck Sun presence bit. This is a graceful degradation feature provided to the Ground that when set to FALSE attempts to use the ATA voltages in the MDP to derive the Sun presence bit. Parameter name with expanded enums: GNC_SDE_USE_DSS_MDP_SUN_PRESENCE_BIT_{ 0 = DSS_MGR_DSS_HEAD_1A }
param.rationale: Use DSS-reported Sun presence bit reported in the MDP

param.sysdesc: Provides the ability to disable the use of the MDP Albedo presence alpha-slit bit on a per-head basis in the event of a stuck Albedo presence bit. Because there are two albedo detection circuits per head, one can be disabled and still provide the necessary functionality. This provides the Ground the ability to detect a stuck bit and disable it to preserve functionality of the head. param.sysdesc: Min EPW commanded
param.rationale: From PROP ATP data, post-hot fire max of 4.9 ms at 22 V with 0.1-ms quantization. So add a little buffer.

param.sysdesc: Tolerance for valve closing time (Tclose) to ensure valve closes and to avoid numerics when on-pulsing near saturation
param.rationale: From PROP ATP data, max difference with mean is 0.2 ms with 0.1-ms quantization. So add a little to 0.2 ms. And want to cover all close times, with max of 5.3 ms. Tclose_hit + tol > 5.3 ms.

param.sysdesc: Enable flag (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled) that specifies whether to set the SRU CDP rate command validity to FALSE (i.e., disabled) or use the ATE-computed validity (i.e., enabled). This parameter only affects the initial state value coming out of RESET and can be changed afterwards via command.
param.rationale: Default value set to enabled so that SRU CDP rate validity will be populated with the ATE determination of rate validity. This is the baseline operations for Europa Clipper.

param.sysdesc: Enable flag (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled) that specifies whether to set the SRU CDP rate command validity to FALSE (i.e., disabled) or use the ATE-computed validity (i.e., enabled) in TEST mode.
param.rationale: Default value set to enabled so that SRU CDP rate validity will be populated with the ATE determination of rate validity. This is the baseline operations for Europa Clipper.

param.sysdesc: Gain A setting for the DSS-A assembly, that is valid until the parameterized date specified in the group parameter linked here
param.rationale: Vendor recommended value for Sun distances 0.65 to 1.78 AU documented in DSS hardware specification (D-101850)

param.sysdesc: The sclk time the DSS gains A are valid until. This parameter can be updated to move the date/time to earlier or later, as deemed appropriate by operators.
param.rationale: The time the spacecraft is at 1.82 AU sun distance

param.sysdesc: The sclk time the DSS gains B are valid until. This parameter can be updated to move the date/time to earlier or later, as deemed appropriate by operators.
param.rationale: The time the spacecraft is crossing back into below 1.82 AU sun distance

param.sysdesc: The sclk time the DSS gains C are valid until. This parameter can be updated to move the date/time to earlier or later, as deemed appropriate by operators.
param.rationale: The last time the spacecraft is crossing into beyond 1.82 AU sun distance

param.sysdesc: The sclk time the DSS gains D are valid until. This parameter can be updated to move the date/time to earlier or later, as deemed appropriate by operators.
param.rationale: The time, at which the spacecraft is crossing into beyond 4.9 AU Sun distance

param.sysdesc: The sclk time the DSS gains E are valid until, which is the end of the prime mission. This parameter can be updated to move the date/time to earlier or later, as deemed appropriate by operators.
param.rationale: The time for the end of prime mission. Distance is 5.12 AU.

param.sysdesc: The sclk time the DSS gains F are valid until, which is the end of a notional extended mission. This parameter was chosen arbitrarily and can be updated to move the date/time to earlier or later, as deemed appropriate by operators.
param.rationale: The time for the end of a notional extended mission. Set for 5 years after the end of the prime mission.

param.sysdesc: The time-out for IMU power on and reset behaviors' check for valid gyro data from the hardware (via 1553). The behaviors check for a parameterized duration of persistent valid data for the maximum time set with this parameter. This time-out is initialized at the of the parameterized validity check. Behaviors and timeout are described in the GNC FDD (D-56145)
param.rationale: Described in the JPL D-56145 and vendor analysis.

param.sysdesc: 2nd word in IMU's 55 deg C .HSC file. Parameter for IMU-A PPSM-A. param.rationale: Value from the FM unit calibration file.

param.sysdesc:
Captures the sum of the following delays that need to be subtracted from T_STROBE before adding the time to each Gyro packet's timestamp:
IMU is producing measurements at > 48 kHz 1) A FIR filter is internally applied to the these high frequency measurements, which imparts up to 332 us of delay 2) The high rate measurements are sum downed to 2 kHz 3) The 2 kHz information is processed across the SPI with an internal 50 us delay 4) The 2 kHz measurements are brought down to 100 Hz using a sync filter, which imparts a delay of 4500 us.
This total delay is 4882 micro seconds
Internal delays are very deterministic. So a 100Hz measurement has built into it a near-deterministic 4882 us of delay and only 9 us of randomness.
Internal delay is provided in Northrop Grumman EICD 6810703, Rev A, Table 4-7.
param.rationale: sum of all internal delays that GNC algorithms cares about

param.sysdesc: This parameter defines the time for IMU Power on and Reset behaviors to start the persistent gyro data validity check. The time is stated in seconds since the 5 A IMU power switch closing in the Power on behavior and since the IMU HW reset commands (NUC High and Lo) were sent to the HW in the Reset behavior. Behaviors and associated timeouts, persistency checks are described in the GNC FDD (D-56145).
param.rationale: Described in the JPL D-56145 and vendor analysis.

param.sysdesc: This parameter defines the value (in seconds) for the IMU Power on and Reset behaviors' Goodness Counter validity check for 1553 gyro data (for all commanded gyros). There is a separate parameter that defines the time-out for a failed Goodness Counter check. There is also a parameter that defines when IMU manager needs to start the time-out and this Goodness Counter check. Behaviors' Goodness Counter validity check and timeout are described in the GNC FDD (D-56145).
param.rationale: Described in the JPL D-56145 and based on vendor analysis.

param.sysdesc: Propulsion venting behavior status stored to Shared memory by the pme_manager. The status is read by the launch behavior. See Propulsion FDD (D-20728) for more details.
param.rationale: The likelihood of having to use the default parameter value before venting in launch is very low. The likelihood of venting success is high. Venting is not a critical event, so even if the venting hadn't completed, it is still fine to move to priming.

param.sysdesc: Propulsion Priming behavior status stored to Shared memory by the pme_manager. The status is read by the launch behavior. See Propulsion FDD (D-20728) for more details. True means propulsion subsystem priming of the prime PM branch has completed successfully.
param.rationale: Priming is a critical event. It is essential to ensure the prime PM branch has primed before first engine use. This parameter will only be used during launch.

param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A NeSeuil (LSB) OH-1 parameter for Hydra Lost in Space. The pixel selection threshold, in LSB. The higher NeSeuil is, the higher the signal of a pixel must be to be considered as potentially part of a star.
param.rationale: Integration time provided by SRU vendor. See DCIL*1674 Section 7.9.5 (SW ICD).

param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A NeSeuil (LSB) OH-2 parameter for Hydra Lost in Space. The pixel selection threshold, in LSB. The higher NeSeuil is, the higher the signal of a pixel must be to be considered as potentially part of a star.
param.rationale: Integration time provided by SRU vendor. See DCIL*1674 Section 7.9.5 (SW ICD).

param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A configuration parameter for Hydra Lost in Space.. Hydra or Europa configuration. 0 = Hydra. 1 = Europa
param.rationale: Integration time provided by SRU vendor. See DCIL*1674 Section 7.9.5 (SW ICD).

param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A NbCycleDes paramter for Hydra Lost in Space.. The parameter that defines the number of "HW window" cycles needed to perform successfully before entering tracking mode. Given Europa Clipper's radiation environment, it's desirable to keep this number as low as possible to enter tracking mode as quickly as possible. For lost-in-space acquisition this NbCycleDes must be set to 1. For designated acquisition the NbCycleDes must be set to 0. Due to a software idiosyncrasy, both settings are equivalent and both specify that one successful HW window cycle is needed before entering tracking mode. Warning: if NbCycleDes is set to 0 during lost-in-space acquisition, this mode will never succeed. Performance of designated acquisition is degraded if NbCycleDes is not equal to zero. Therefore, a memory write must be done before and after designated acquisition to set this parameter to zero and then to reset it to one.
param.rationale: Integration time provided by SRU vendor. See DCIL*1674 Section 7.9.5 (SW ICD).

param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A NbITRSeqFen parameter for Hydra Lost in Space. The parameter defines the time (in ETR) allocated to the CPU to process the data during the "HW window" phase of designated acquisition
param.rationale: Integration time provided by SRU vendor. See DCIL*1674 Section 7.9.5 (SW ICD).

param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A TailleFenSeq parameter (1 of 2) for Hydra Lost in Space. The parameter (1 of 2) that defines (in pixels) the size of a HW window during acquisition mode. For designated acquisition mode, the specification requires a tolerance of +/- 1 degrees on the a priori quaternion provided by the AOCS to the SRU, therefore it needs to be adjusted to [114 104] to fit this value.
param.rationale: Integration time provided by SRU vendor. See DCIL*1674 Section 7.9.5 (SW ICD).

param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A TailleFenSeq parameter (2 of 2) for Hydra Lost in Space. The parameter (2 of 2) that defines (in pixels) the size of a HW window during acquisition mode. param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A NbCycleDes paramter for Designated Acquisition.. The parameter that defines the number of "HW window" cycles needed to perform successfully before entering tracking mode. Given Europa Clipper's radiation environment, it's desirable to keep this number as low as possible to enter tracking mode as quickly as possible. For lost-in-space acquisition this NbCycleDes must be set to 1. For designated acquisition the NbCycleDes must be set to 0. Due to a software idiosyncrasy, both settings are equivalent and both specify that one successful HW window cycle is needed before entering tracking mode. Warning: if NbCycleDes is set to 0 during lost-in-space acquisition, this mode will never succeed. Performance of designated acquisition is degraded if NbCycleDes is not equal to zero. Therefore, a memory write must be done before and after designated acquisition to set this parameter to zero and then to reset it to one.
param.rationale: Integration time provided by SRU vendor. See DCIL*1674 Section 7.9.5 (SW ICD).

param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A NbITRSeqFen parameter for Designated Acquisition. The parameter defines the time (in ETR) allocated to the CPU to process the data during the "HW window" phase of designated acquisition
param.rationale: Integration time provided by SRU vendor. See DCIL*1674 Section 7.9.5 (SW ICD).

param.sysdesc: SRU EU-A TailleFenSeq parameter (1 of 2) for Designated Acquisition. The parameter (1 of 2) that defines (in pixels) the size of a HW window during acquisition mode. For designated acquisition mode, the specification requires a tolerance of +/- 1 degrees on the a priori quaternion provided by the AOCS to the SRU, therefore it needs to be adjusted to [114 104] to fit this value.
param.rationale: Integration time provided by SRU vendor. See DCIL*1674 Section 7.9.5 (SW ICD).

param.sysdesc: The duration the SRU EU Power on behavior waits for data flow after the SRU EU PSS is switched on and before checking the SRU mode.
param.rationale: Based on hardware level testing

param.sysdesc: Time-out for the SRU Take_Photo behavior, while the behavior waits to confirm that the photo was taken. If this time-out is reached before the photo confirmation and before return of SRU mode to standby, the behavior fails out.
param.rationale: Based on hardware level testing

param.sysdesc: Time-out for the SRU Take_Photo sub-behavior, Retrieve Pixel Data. If this time-out is reached before the sub-behavior successfully completes, the behavior fails out.
param.rationale: Based on max image size of 600x600 pixels, SRU only reading 476 words per read, frequency of SRU manager memory read frequency (every 5 8 Hz RTI) and assuming every other read is missed when photo mode is treated as opportunistic data.

param.sysdesc: 1st bypass parameter in the acquisition scheme of SRU manager and for Designated Track (defined in GNC-FDD). If set to enable, the acquisition scheme behavior will skip obscuration flag check.
param.rationale: Obscuration flag is expected to be used majority of the time.

param.sysdesc: 2nd bypass parameter in the acquisition scheme of SRU manager and for Designated Track (defined in GNC-FDD). If set to enable, the acquisition scheme behavior will skip the second Designated Track attempt and move on to either Designated Acquisition or Hydra Lost-in-space logics.
param.rationale: Designated Track is expected to be used majority of the time.

param.sysdesc: 3rd bypass parameter in the acquisition scheme of SRU manager and the only one for Designated Acquisition (defined in GNC-FDD). If set to enable, the acquisition scheme behavior will skip the Designated Acquisition logic part of the scheme and move on to Hydra Lost-in-space.
param.rationale: Designated Acquisition is expected to be used majority of the time.

param.sysdesc:
Additional latency correction in the SRU MDP timetag that goes to the GNC algorithms.
Allows user to apply a parameterized time offset (param_t_mdp_latency_correction) to the SRU measurement time tag, which is in addition to the expected latency compensation that is hardcoded in the SRU MGR relative to the mode code 17 time (i.e., t_mc17 - SRU_MGR_RTI_8HZ_SECS + ((F64) y * 20e-6) + param_t_mdp_latency_correction);. In flight, this correction parameter is expected to always be set to zero under nominal data transport and would only be updated under off-nominal conditions to be diagnosed by the ground. In ground testing with the SRU EGSE, this parameter will need to be routinely updated to properly reflect the non-flight-like added latency injected by the image generation process of the EGSE.
param.rationale: no latency correction applied

param.sysdesc: Minimum number of reliable stars the SRU OH trying to acquire from Lost_in_Space must see before the device manager deems tracking successful and to avoid the SRU manager persistency check.
param.rationale: Default shall never be less than 4. Value is based on combination of vendor, SRU HW team, and GNC CA team recommendation

param.sysdesc: Minimum number of 8 Hz RTI counts before SRU manager starts checking for ATM (Tracking) mode data (modes 11 or 15). This ties into device manager's decision to declare success in tracking in all acquisition modes (lost-in-space, designated track, and designated acquisition).
param.rationale: Value is based on combination of vendor, SRU HW team, and GNC CA team recommendation

param.sysdesc:
This parameter is used by SRU manager after the initial logic to check the number of reliable stars fails.
This parameter is the total of the hardware param NbMaxAttNoCohMultiTO (number of consecutive invalid measurements before SRU HW falls out of HW track into standby) plus 4 (8 Hz) RTI's.
NbMaxAttNoCohMultiTO can only be changed via HW memory write, so ground needs to be aware of the value it is set to, as it directly affects this FSW parameter.
param.rationale: Value is based on combination of vendor, SRU HW team, and GNC CA team recommendation
