param.sysdesc:
Enables or disables the HRC logic fault response.
FSW will configure the hardware to the desired state during any transition to UART_HS_ONLY mode.
If enabled, FSW will clear bit 4 of LRC register BDS Power Control Register (BPC). If disabled, FSW will set bit 4 of LRC register BPC.
This response, which is implemented within the LRC FPGA, when enabled, powers off the HRC and associated circuitry if a bit upset is detected in the HRC configuration RAM.
If disabled, the HRC will continue to operate with the bit error still present. This means there is a possibility the BDS will not function correctly which could lead to loss of commands to instruments, loss of science data, etc.

when_applied.explanation: Applied during the next transition to UART_HS_ONLY

param.rationale: Analysis suggests there will be less science data loss if this response is disabled.

Global enable/disable boolean for PRT Rail Detection. If enabled, thrm_mgr will flag railed PRTs as invalid upstream of any use in on-board autonomy. A "railed" PRT has a value at the extreme ends of the PRT measurement range (in DN), with the thresholds defined in THRM_PRT_RAIL_THRSH_HI and LO.
param.rationale: Enable rail detection by default

param.sysdesc: Defines the threshold in DN for PRTs that have railed on the hi (hot) end of the measurement range. Example: if value = 10, PRT values within 10 DN of the max DN value are considered railed.
param.rationale: Default to top 5 DN for high rail limit

param.sysdesc: Defines the threshold in DN for PRTs that have railed on the lo (cold ) end of the measurement range. Example: if value = 10, PRT values within 10 DN of the min DN value are considered railed.
param.rationale: Default to bottom 5 DN for low rail limit

param.sysdesc: Global enable/disable boolean for commanding both PME heaters on/off together when both PMEs are on. If enabled, and both PMEs are ON, command both PME heaters.
param.rationale: disabled by default; allow for enabling upon request

param.default_value: ENABLE -- PRE_SEP POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST
param.rationale: System response is enabled for all modes except SYS_TEST

param.sysdesc: MON_JOI_MAX_TIMEOUT system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: On event monitor

param.sysdesc: Parameter to total delays in the do_deltaV behavior when determining when to issue the do_deltaV behavior. the do_deltaV behavior will be called this many seconds prior to the burn start time
param.rationale: Default accounts for all of the delays in the do_deltav Behavior during JOI. Nominally this is the sum of the following 600s turn settling time, 120s ACC calibration duration, 200s pre-burn settling, 300s GNC turn settling, and 19s misc other delays in behavior.

param.sysdesc: The Launch Behavior post separation stage is updated and stored for recovery from a fault. See Launch FDD for stages and details.
param.rationale: This is the safest stage to re-enter if the defaults are used to ensure that priming occurs and venting is not repeated after priming.

param.sysdesc:
This parameter identifies whether this is the first solar array deployment attempt. It is used to determine the duration of the thermal conditioning roll prior to solar array deployment.
It is initialized to TRUE on exit from Launch Behavior Idle. It is set to FALSE when thermal_roll_duration_1 is completed in the Thermal Roll and Deployment Preparation Stage Step See Launch FDD for details.
param.rationale: It is safest to assume the solar array deployment has not been attempted previously and complete the longer duration thermal conditioning roll.

param.sysdesc: This parameter contains the number of hold down cables to be cut on each solar array wing before the GNC system is put into ControlIdle3RS.
param.rationale: The first 8 solar array hold downs on each wing can be safely cut without the arrays deploying until the 9th HDRM is actuated.

param.sysdesc: This is the time, after separation from the launch vehicle, that the system waits to begin post separation configuration. It is meant to allow for the shock from the separation event to settle prior to capturing the earth direction proxy with the IMU, turning on the DSSs, warming up the TWTAs. It also allows the spacecraft to drift away from the launch vehicle a short distance prior to transitioning to RCS venting.
param.rationale: 2 seconds beyond the 1s persistence is an estimate for when the separation event shock will have adequately settled.

param.sysdesc: This parameter is the duration for the thermal conditioning roll prior to solar array deployment.
param.rationale: 1 hour is the estimated time needed to get to a safe thermal condition for deployment.

param.sysdesc: This parameter is the duration for the thermal conditioning roll prior to subsequent the solar array deployment attempts, after the first attempted deployment.
param.rationale: 1 hour is the estimated time needed to get to a safe thermal condition for deployment.

param.sysdesc: This parameter is the duration of high rate IMU data collection. High rate IMU data is collected from the start of the HDRM actuation until the solar arrays have been fully deployed.
param.rationale: Includes 2125s for actuation of the first 8 HDRMs on each wing + 250s for actuation of the last HDRM on each wing + 10min for passive deployment + 30s for shock settling + 10min margin.

param.sysdesc: This parameter is the duration of the last HDRM actuation on each solar array wing. It is used in the calculation of when the GNC system is idle during the solar array deployment and in when to check the microswitches for deployment confirmation.
param.rationale: Nominal max time for one HDRM to fully cut the hold down cable. 125s is the max allowable actuation time with a 5s tolerance applied.

param.sysdesc: This parameter is the duration for the solar array to passively deploy from the time that the last restraint is fully cut until the solar array wings are latched. This parameter is used to determine how long GNC needs to be idle and when to check the microswitches for deployment confirmation.
param.rationale: 10min time for passive solar array deployment.

param.sysdesc: This parameter is the duration for the solar array deployment dynamics to settle after latching and before checking the microswitches for confirmation of that the solar arrays are deployed.
param.rationale: 30s Estimate of time for the latching dynamics to settle out.

param.sysdesc: This parameter captures the status of the launch behavior. This flag is set to TRUE by the LNCH_DO_LAUNCH command and FALSE by the LNCH_ABORT_LAUNCH command.
param.rationale: after the launch phase completes for the entire rest of the mission this flag should be FALSE and the system should start with this flag FALSE prior to the DO_LAUNCH command.

param.sysdesc: The sclk time the GNC system remains in idle mode until. This parameter originally gets set to the start time of the launch behavior by the LNCH_DO_LAUNCH command so that it is out of the way. It gets overwritten during the Solar Array Deployment stage of the launch behavior so that GNC is in idle throughout the solar array unfurling.
param.rationale: The default value should be a time known to be prior to any launch opportunity.

param.sysdesc: MON_LAUNCH_VENTING_FAILURE local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: On-event monitor

param.sysdesc: MON_LAUNCH_VENTING_FAILURE system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: On-event monitor

param.sysdesc: MON_LAUNCH_VENTING_FAILURE local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_LAUNCH_VENTING_FAILURE system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- POST_SEP DISABLE -- TEST PRE_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI
param.rationale: Can only trip during Launch Behavior/POST_SEP

param.sysdesc: MON_LAUNCH_PRIMING_FAILURE local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: On-event monitor

param.rationale: On-event monitor

param.sysdesc: MON_LAUNCH_PRIMING_FAILURE local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.default_value: ENABLE -- POST_SEP DISABLE -- TEST PRE_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI
param.rationale: Can only trip during Launch Behavior/POST_SEP

param.sysdesc: This parameter is used for how long to wait for a fault protection response to switch to the secondary branch after a prime branch only venting failure, before continuing with the launch behavior.
param.rationale: This is an initial estimate for the time from FP.

param.sysdesc: This parameter is used for how long to wait for a fault protection response after a priming failure, before continuing with the launch behavior.
param.rationale: This is an initial estimate for the time from FP.

param.sysdesc:
Variable to force all future GNC attitude control actions (nominal or off-nominal) to use a more robust, Super-safe attitude controller. Super-safe controllers are designed to be robust to a range of SC configurations that span: stowed, any one-array deployed and latched (other still stowed), and both arrays deployed and latched.
It is set to FALSE on exit Launch Behavior Idle It is set to TRUE during the Solar Array Deployment Stage right before the last HDRM actuation, because from this point forward the solar arrays are no longer guaranteed to be in the stowed configuration.
lnch_control pulls this value from the REU shared memory into an SBS channel of the same name. GNC will query this SBS state and use that to determine weather to use the stowed controller or the supersafe controller.
param.rationale: It should be safest to default to the super safe controller

param.sysdesc: FSW will not set the separation status to separated until the output of one of the PBCs, either (BW-A1 AND BW-B1) OR (BW-A2 AND BW- B2), shows separated for a parameterized length of time equal to LNCH_BREAKWIRE_PERSISTENCE
param.rationale: 1 second will allow for several data points before the separation detection is declared protecting against some FPGA failures

param.sysdesc: This parameter is used by local fault response LCL_RSP_IDLE_CONTROL to put the spacecraft in an IDLE state (i.e. not under RCS control) if a rate control monitor trips and all system responses have dead-ended. This is the dead-end strategy for the launch phase after the launch behavior has commanded the solar arrays to be deployed. The launch behavior will leave this parameter set to. Ground operators will set it to FALSE after the wings are verified to be fully deployed and good GNC control is confirmed.
param.rationale: For most of the mission, outside of this part of the launch phase) the dead-ending strategy relies on this value being FALSE and not going to an IDLE state

param.sysdesc: After the launch behavior calls the PWR_PME_HDRM_SETUP behavior, this parameter is used as a threshold voltage to check that the setup was successful and power is getting to the HDRM SHPC busses. It is set to a value above the expected noise level and below the expected voltage.
param.rationale: This value is above the expected noise and below the expected voltage

param.sysdesc: This parameter is used for how long to wait for a fault protection response to interrupt the launch behavior after a failure deployment bus turn on failure, before continuing with the launch behavior.
param.rationale: This is an initial estimate for the time from FP.

param.sysdesc: This holds the target system mode that the spacecraft will boot to following a reset. It is autonomously updated as the spacecraft changes modes and it can be updated by command.
param.rationale: Specified in D-56165 System Mode FDD

param.sysdesc: The duration set for the DO_3RS behavior during which, the behavior checks whether a solar eclipse is still in progress or not based on the eclipse table. See GNC FDD for the behavior details.
param.rationale: GNC FDD

param.sysdesc: Initial solar arrays offset from the home position set before start of Sun search in DO-3RS as defined in the GNC FDD
param.rationale: GNC FDD

param.sysdesc: Accelerometer calibration duration used in DO_DELTAV and DO_MOM_MGMT behaviors. This parameter is used to command the calibration duration to be used by GNC algorithms and is also used to determine the delay that the behavior should wait for the calibration to finish before it moves on to the next step of the activity.
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis

param.sysdesc: Turn settling delay after the turn to the burn attitude.
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis

param.sysdesc: Pre deltaV maneuver settle delay.
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis

param.sysdesc: Post deltaV maneuver settle delay.
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis

param.sysdesc: Delay to allow for rotation of solar arrays to complete from the deltaV position to the commanded position after the burn.
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis

param.sysdesc: Solar array rotation rate in the deltaV behavior.
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis

param.sysdesc: Solar array rotation acceleration in the deltaV behavior.
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis

param.sysdesc: Parameter for motion behavior, Do_PointRCWA3J, to determine whether to slew the spacecraft and articulate the solar arrays in parallel or in series.
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis

param.sysdesc: Delay after transition from RCS control to RWA control to remove attitude and rate error. The delay exists for post DeltaV maneuver transitions from RCS to RWA control. The behavior waits this parameterized delay to remove the attitude/rate error that was caused from being on RCS control prior to the mode transition.
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis

param.sysdesc: The global time-out set for the Acquire3J behavior in the Motion Behavior Module. Failure for the behavior to complete before the timeout threshold results in the behavior declaring a fault and exiting.
param.rationale: 5 mins for SRU acquisition per OH plus 30 mins for star search slew.

param.sysdesc: The max amount of time a SRU OH is expected to take to acquire stars. This parameter is used by the Acquire3J behavior in the Motion Behavior Module.
param.rationale: 30 secs for SRU acquisition per OH for cruise

param.sysdesc: The parameter to enable or disable the star search turn in the Do_Acquire3J behavior as defined in GNC FDD rev B.
param.rationale: Majority of the time, the turn will not be needed. Based on SFP recommendation.

param.sysdesc: The parameter to specify size of the star search turn in the Do_Acquire3J behavior as defined in GNC FDD rev B. This parameter only specifies the size about the spacecraft y axis, because the turn is purely a y-axis turn. If the turn is disabled, then this parameter does not apply to the behavior.
param.rationale: A 180 deg turn maximizes chances for the SRU heads to acquire. It also helps reduce unintended deltaV, which is important for Tour.

param.sysdesc: The global time-out set for the 3RS behavior in the Motion Behavior Module. Failure for the behavior to complete before the timeout threshold results in the behavior declaring a fault and exiting.
param.rationale: 9Hr (Worst case eclipse)+30min(front end buffer in MBM to complete an existing sun search)+30mins for post eclipse sun search+30mins buffer

param.sysdesc: Parameter for motion behavior, Do_PointRCS3J, to determine whether to slew the spacecraft and articulate the solar arrays in parallel or in series
param.rationale: Slew the spacecraft and articulate the solar arrays in parallel

param.sysdesc: The global time-out set for the RCS3J behavior in the Motion Behavior Module. Failure for the behavior to complete before the timeout threshold results in the behavior declaring a fault and exiting.
param.rationale: 30 min margin on top of longuest branch duration

param.sysdesc: The global time-out set for the RWA3J behavior in the Motion Behavior Module. Failure for the behavior to complete before the timeout threshold results in the behavior declaring a fault and exiting.
param.rationale: 30 min margin on top of longuest branch duration

param.sysdesc: Solar array reference position for deltaV maneuvers. In the deltaV behavior the arrays are articulated to this parameterized position sometime before the start of the burn. The solar arrays maintain this position throughout the burn and after. A post maneuver command in the behavior will articulate the arrays to a new position
param.rationale: GNC CDR analysis. This position is needed to meet deltaV performance requirements.

param.sysdesc: Solar array reference position after the completion of deltaV maneuvers. In the deltaV behavior a post maneuver command in the behavior will articulate the arrays to this parameterized position.
param.rationale: Reference position for ground comm after completion of maneuvers.

param.sysdesc: The minimum deltaV burn magnitude for which the desire is to open the back-up propulsion branch Isolation Latch Valves. If the commanded argument to the on-board DeltaV behavior is greater than this parameter, the back-up branch isolation LV's are opened by the behavior to prevent the Back-Pressure-Relief function from getting triggered. See Flight Rule, prop-A-0002, for more information.
param.rationale: 1.43 m/s is approximately the deltaV magnitude associated with 150 secs burn assuming a conservative 6001 kg FS wet mass. 150 secs is a result of a propulsion subsystem thermal analysis documented in PM CDR.

param.sysdesc: The deltaH threshold for the MBM Momentum Management to assess the on-board estimated dH against. If norm of the behavior computed dH is less than this parameterized threshold, the Mom Management behavior will exit pre-maturely.
param.rationale: Recommendation from GNC subsystem

param.sysdesc: Parameter in the Do_DeltaV behavior to determine the power state of the back-up PME after the back-up branch isolation LV's have been opened for maneuvers longer than 150 secs (part of the behavior). It is expected that the back-up PME will only stay on for JOI; however, this parameter provides flexibility for other maneuvers in flight.
param.rationale: The back-up PME is potentially only needed on for JOI.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_LAUNCH_3RS_TIMEOUT system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: On event monitor

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_LAUNCH_3RS_TIMEOUT system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST PRE_SEP
param.rationale: Default for monitors calling SYS_RSP_SWAP_ECE

param.sysdesc: The global time-out set for the Launch 3RS behavior in the Motion Behavior Module. Failure for the behavior to complete before the timeout threshold results in the behavior declaring a fault and exiting.
param.rationale: 30 min margin on top of longest branch duration

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- PRE_SEP POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST
param.rationale: System response is enabled for all modes except SYS_TEST

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK, GROUND_ENABLE threshold parameter. 0->Disable; 1->enable
param.rationale: default to disabled

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK, TIME_INIT_PRESS_AVG threshold parameter.
param.rationale: default value

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK, MAX_TIME_VALID_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: longest expected outage (14 days in seconds)

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK, TIME_DISS_TRANSIENTS_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Default agreed to value

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK, PRESS_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: 1psi is the default value

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_FL_TANK system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Do not want to false trip for a spurious measurement

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- PRE_SEP POST_SEP RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST
param.rationale: System response is enabled for all modes except SYS_TEST

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK, GROUND_ENABLE threshold parameter. 0->disabled; 1-> enabled
param.rationale: default to disabled

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK, TIME_INIT_PRESS_AVG threshold parameter.
param.rationale: default value

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK, MAX_TIME_VALID_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: longest expected outage (14 days in seconds)

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK, TIME_DISS_TRANSIENTS_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: default value

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK, PRESS_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: 1psi is the threshold

param.sysdesc: MON_PROP_LEAK_OX_TANK system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Do not want to false trip for a spurious measurement

param.sysdesc: This parameter, when set to enabled, results in MBM exiting the DO_MOM_MGMT behavior if microswitch tlm from the propulsion LV's indicate that the LV(s) failed to open. The LV opening happens as part of the PrepPrimeRCS step in the mom mgmt behavior. See latest GNC FDD D-56145 for more details and the behavior diagram.
param.rationale: Microswitch failure has low likelihood. Enabling prevents a potential safing of the spacecraft if LV's truly haven't opened.

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_MBM_SA_SOFT_INIT_FAIL local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: On event monitor

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_MBM_SA_SOFT_INIT_FAIL system persistence parameter.
param.rationale: On event monitor

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_MBM_SA_SOFT_INIT_FAIL local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: Per FM design philosophy, all local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_GNC_MBM_SA_SOFT_INIT_FAIL system response enable parameter for all system modes.
param.default_value: ENABLE -- RCS RWA SAFE JOI DISABLE -- TEST PRE_SEP POST_SEP
param.rationale: No SADA articulation in Launch Behavior/POST_SEP

param.sysdesc: The time-out set for the soft initialization behavior in the Motion Behavior Module. Failure for the behavior to complete before the timeout threshold results in the behavior declaring a fault and exiting.
param.rationale: Value to ride through an REU Resync or PME Reset

param.sysdesc: This is the maximum operational temperature threshold at which the instrument should be before powering on. Zone temp to check against is THRM_ETHEMIS_WARM_ZN_CTRL_TEMP in Helix.
param.rationale: Based on max operational AFT

param.sysdesc: This parameter overrides the temperature check in the E-THEMIS power on behavior.
param.rationale: Temperature checks should be enforced unless there is a problem with the sensors.

param.sysdesc: This is the minimum operational temperature threshold at which the instrument should be before powering on. Zone temp to check against is THRM_ETHEMIS_WARM_ZN_CTRL_TEMP in Helix.
param.rationale: Based on min operational AFT

param.sysdesc: MON_ETHEMIS_NO_HS local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Provide time for other instruments to run a response; need to be longer than the overproduction monitor pers;long enough to allow temp No HS

param.sysdesc: MON_ETHEMIS_NO_HS local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_ETHEMIS_HS_DATA_OVERPROD local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Robustness to false trips

param.sysdesc: MON_ETHEMIS_HS_DATA_OVERPROD local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_ETHEMIS_UPSET_RECOVERY local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: Robustness to false trips

param.sysdesc: MON_ETHEMIS_UPSET_RECOVERY local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_ETHEMIS_SURV_ZN_TOO_HOT local persistence parameter.
param.rationale: baseline time for too hot monitors

param.sysdesc: MON_ETHEMIS_SURV_ZN_TOO_HOT local response enable parameter.
param.rationale: All local response default value is ENABLE

param.sysdesc: MON_ETHEMIS_SURV_ZN_TOO_HOT, OP_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: Max Flight Allowable

param.sysdesc: MON_MISE_CCA_ZN_TEMP_VIOLATION, OP_COLD_THRSH threshold parameter.
param.rationale: At JPL, we tested the cryocooler at 180 K with a little extra power than planned in flight. The pistons did not hit the end stops. Therefore, 180 K has some margin. The PRTs have 5 K of error, so 185 K is a good setpoint. Note that the op cold AFT is 195 K and the op cold PFT is 180 K. The 185 K monitor setpoint is bounded within the PFT
